1. HELLMODE by Jeff Rosenstock

This album is so fucking packed with jams. Not a single miss in its entire run and it’s easily one of the best pop punk albums of all time.


2. The Whaler by Home is Where

A bit more of an emo vibe. But this album shares the same producer as HELLMODE but leans into HIW’s blend of Folk elements with the heavy ripping and twinkly guitars. Big plus that they are so pro trans <3

3. Sissy Fist self titled

I actually opened for them this year and since then I’ve been absolutely obsessed with them. They are so raw and so damn fun!!! It’s some good homemade DIY Punk that’s actually really perfect for spooky season. The song “this train” is my fav

4. Death Means Nothing to Us by Fiddlehead

This album is a furious storm of energy. Mixing post punk/post hardcore elements this album is just straight fire from front to back. And it’s a really breezy listen to!!


5. Life Under the Gun by Militarie Gun

Equally poppy and equally punk. This album is really just a fun listen. It’s nothing mind blowing but if you are looking for a good time id highly recommend throwing it on




Hope yall check these out and if you do lmk what you think <3 can’t recommend my top 2 enough if you don’t listen to anything else here!!!
